election_dates.primarySnippet: Tex. Elec. Code § 41.007(a): The general primary election date is the first Tuesday in March in each even-numbered year.
election_dates.generalSnippet: Tex. Elec. Code § 41.002: The general election for state and county officers shall be held on the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November in even-numbered years.

state_background_check.value: No — Texas's felony-disqualification requirement (Tex. Elec. Code § 141.001(a)(4)) applies only to "a public elective office in this state" by its own text, not federal office; separately, the U.S. Constitution's own qualifications for Congress (age, citizenship, residency) can't be added to by any state, so this doesn't reach U.S. House or Senate candidates either way
state_background_check.snippet: Tex. Elec. Code § 141.001: "(a) To be eligible to be a candidate for, or elected or appointed to, a public elective office in this state, a person must: ... (4) have not been finally convicted of a felony from which the person has not been pardoned or otherwise released from the resulting disabilities..." Congressional qualifications are set exclusively by the U.S. Constitution, confirmed per https://www.everycrsreport.com/reports/R41946.html: "the Framers intended the Constitution to be the exclusive source of qualifications for Members of Congress, and that the Framers thereby 'divested' States of any power to add qualifications."

platform.value: Fight for policies that open doors for families through access to good jobs and fair wages, building strong local economies
platform.snippet: Every person deserves access to good jobs and fair wages. Strong communities begin with strong local economies, and I will fight for policies that open doors for families in Congressional District 14 (TX).

platform.value: Support investment in teachers, modernized classrooms, and pathways to success for every child
platform.snippet: I support investment in teachers, modernized classrooms, and pathways to success for every child.

platform.value: Support smart infrastructure, energy reliability, and resilient systems that protect families and businesses
platform.snippet: I support smart infrastructure, energy reliability, and resilient systems that protect our families and our businesses.

platform.topic: Mental Health, Public Safety, and Homelessness
platform.value: Support law enforcement and believe true safety requires stability, mental health support, and opportunity
platform.snippet: I support law enforcement, and I believe true safety requires stability, mental health support, and opportunity. Real safety means caring for people, not ignoring the challenges they face.

platform.value: Support strengthening and restoring the Affordable Care Act so people can access affordable and reliable healthcare
platform.snippet: Every citizen should have access to affordable and reliable healthcare without long travel times or overwhelming costs. I support strengthening and restoring the Affordable Care Act so people can manage health concerns and still maintain a good quality of life.

platform.value: Support policy that will roll back tariffs which have raised prices, clear barriers to build more affordable housing, and promote more competition in industries ranging from healthcare to food processing
platform.snippet: To build affordability in this economy, We need policy that will roll back tariffs, which have raised prices, clearing barriers to build more affordable housing. Promoting more competition in industries ranging from healthcare to food processing.

bio_summary.value: A lifelong Port Arthur native, former Mayor Thurman Bill Bartie has dedicated his career to public service, education, ministry, and community leadership. From his historic election as the first African American Justice of the Peace in Precinct 8 to his work as former Mayor, his life reflects commitment, compassion, and integrity. Learn more about his story and vision for Congressional District 14 (TX).

marital_status.value: Married to Brenda Weber, a Pearland schoolteacher, for over 30 years
marital_status.snippet: Weber has been married to Brenda Weber, a Pearland schoolteacher, for over 30 years. They have three children and eight grandchildren.

civic_affiliations.value: Weber was a city councilman of Pearland, Texas, for six years. He also served as a Brazoria County grand jury commissioner, a Brazoria County Redistricting Committee member, a Texas Republican Party Convention delegate, president of Brazoria County Cities Association, a Brazoria County Republican Party member, and chair of the Pearland Area Republican Party Headquarters.

platform.value: Believes in limited government and a capitalist economy, and is concerned about out-of-control spending by government and the enormous debt future Americans will inherit
platform.snippet: As a firm believer in limited government and a capitalist economy, I am very concerned about the out-of-control spending by our government, and the enormous debt future Americans will inherit.

platform.value: Continue working toward nuclear research priorities and reforms that prioritize the use of limited research dollars, maintain R&D capabilities and develop cutting edge nuclear technology domestically
platform.snippet: We will continue working toward our nuclear research priorities and reforms that prioritize the use of limited research dollars; we cannot be left behind in this field.

platform.value: Support regular passage of a Water Resources Development Act (WRDA) every two years to continue improving America's ports, locks, dams, inland waterways, and other water resources infrastructure
platform.snippet: Congress is back on track to authorizing water resources infrastructure improvements every two years, and we must maintain this schedule to strengthen our economic competitiveness.

platform.value: Supports the right to keep and bear arms as fundamental to a free society
platform.snippet: The Second Amendment to the U.S. Constitution affirms a right that is fundamental to a free society, which in turn depends on personal responsibility.

platform.topic: First Amendment and Rule of Law
platform.value: Supports peaceful protests and freedom of speech while maintaining that those who break laws must be met with swift justice
platform.snippet: Peaceful protests are an American right, and all voices deserve to be heard. That said, violence is never the answer. America is a nation of laws, and those who break our laws must be met with swift justice.

platform.value: Restore state and local control of education to better serve students
platform.snippet: We need to restore state and local control of education to better serve students across the country.

platform.value: Opposes federal intervention in education, which has come at the expense of state and local control and saddled teachers with paperwork compliance burden
platform.snippet: ever-growing federal intervention in education has come at the expense of state and local control, has saddled teachers and school leaders with a tremendous paperwork compliance burden, and has failed to effect meaningful gains in education.

platform.value: Voted to require the EPA to base its regulations on science that is publicly available and therefore verifiable by outside researchers
platform.snippet: Last Congress, I voted to increase transparency, independence, and scientific integrity at the EPA. The House passed H.R. 1430, the Honest and Open New EPA Science Treatment (HONEST) Act of 2017, which would require the EPA to base its regulations on science that is publicly available and therefore verifiable by outside researchers.

platform.value: Supported strengthening the independence of the EPA advisory board by providing increased opportunities for public comments and reducing conflicts of interest
platform.snippet: I also supported H.R. 1431, the EPA Science Advisory Board Reform Act, which would strengthen the independence of the advisory board by providing increased opportunities for public comments and reducing conflicts of interest.

platform.value: Will continue to promote fairness, transparency, and public participation, as well as other commonsense reforms that ensure unbiased science at the EPA
platform.snippet: As a member of the House Committee on Science, Space, and Technology, I will continue to promote fairness, transparency, and public participation, as well as other commonsense reforms that ensure unbiased science at the EPA.

platform.value: Believes the answers are found through hard choices to cut spending and to limit the government
platform.snippet: The answers are found through hard choices to cut spending and to limit the government, thereby ensuring a stronger, safer America for tomorrow.

platform.value: Generally opposes deficit spending but recognizes extraordinary times may require strategic intervention to maintain national stability
platform.snippet: While I generally oppose deficit spending, I realize these are extraordinary times, requiring strategic intervention to maintain national stability.

platform.value: Supported the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act which lowers taxes for all Americans by reducing every single tax bracket and nearly doubles the standard deduction for everyone
platform.snippet: In reforming the tax code, we lower taxes for all Americans by reducing every single tax bracket. The standard deduction has nearly doubled for everyone.

platform.value: Will continue to ensure that Israel has the capabilities it needs to deter aggression, to protect its people, and, when necessary, to fight back against its adversaries.
platform.snippet: I will continue to ensure that Israel has the capabilities it needs to deter aggression, to protect its people, and, when necessary, to fight back against its adversaries.

platform.value: Will continue to work with colleagues in Congress to ensure that American interests are protected and to better increase security around the world.
platform.snippet: I will continue to work with my colleagues in Congress to ensure that American interests are protected and to better increase security around the world.

platform.value: Supports free trade conducted on an even playing field, believing that when trade is both free and fair, America is eminently competitive.
platform.snippet: I support free trade, and I believe it should be conducted on an even playing field. When trade is both free and fair, America is eminently competitive.

platform.value: All Americans should have access to affordable health care
platform.snippet: I believe that all Americans should have access to affordable health care.

platform.value: Support repealing the current law and replacing it with less costly and less burdensome alternatives
platform.snippet: Obamacare has proven that it is not the solution to expand access and lower costs, which is why I support repealing the current law and replacing it with less costly and less burdensome alternatives.

platform.value: Allow individuals to purchase health insurance across state lines to spur competition
platform.snippet: Commonsense alternatives would spur competition by allowing individuals to purchase health insurance across state lines

platform.value: Must secure the border as a prerequisite for immigration reform to be effective
platform.snippet: Until the border is secured, immigration reform will not be effective.

platform.value: Essential to have strong borders and enforce immigration laws
platform.snippet: To ensure our security, it is essential that we have strong borders and enforce our immigration laws.

platform.value: Providing for the needs of veterans is included in the mandate to provide for the common defense
platform.snippet: In my view, this includes providing for the needs of our veterans, as well.

platform.value: Will continue to advocate and work to allocate funds to ensure veterans receive the services they earned
platform.snippet: I will continue to advocate and work to allocate funds to ensure our veterans receive the services they earned.

bio_summary.value: Randy Weber is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, anti-socialist and second amendment supporter fighting to make our Texas values heard in Washington, D.C. Randy is a third-generation Texan who has called the Gulf Coast home for nearly 70 years. He has lived in a 20-mile radius his entire life. He is a graduate of Ross Sterling High School, Alvin Community College, and the University of Houston Clear Lake. As a small business owner, Weber built his air conditioning company on a strong work ethic and common sense, which he learned from watching his father own his business.
